name: Rudie Sounds 15 years JUB  + Hjalmar B Allstars
description:
15 years of Rudie Sounds. Let's blow the roof off.

We're bringing the prominent band Hjalmar B-Allstars all the way from Gothenburg to lay down their irresistible reggae grooves.
 
This won't be just another concert—it's a full-on party. 
And to kick things into high gear, our special guests Dr. Sure Shot & Plattenanne (Kiel) will be holding it down on the decks from the jump.

Then, once the band wraps, Rudie Sounds themselves take over to keep the dance floor burning 'til the last drop.

Saturday, September 5th — MIR. 20:00 sharp.
🎟️ Early bird: 250 NOK via Tikkio https://tikkio.com/events/63861 (+15 NOK fee)
🚪 At the door:  350 NOK

More info: rudiesounds.no
